t: A palm-size Intel PC with a small Raspberry Pi chip for wiring projects.
steps: Buy the board or a kit from the DFRobot store. Kits add a Wi-Fi card.
Get a 15 volt USB-C Power Delivery charger, an HDMI monitor, a keyboard and a mouse.
Download Ubuntu or Windows from the LattePanda download page and install it from a USB stick.
Pick the RP2040 MicroPython port in Thonny and blink an LED on the 36-pin header.
Read the official pinout page before you wire a sensor.
Try the Arduino guide with the arduino-pico core next.
meta: Open Code. From $339. A few stores.
